title: Answer
description: Schema for a single structured answer entry in the FullStackMastery Question Bank. Each answer maps to a question via question_id.

question_id.description: Foreign key linking this answer to its question in questions.json. Must match an existing question_id.

_captured_at.description: ISO timestamp of when this answer was captured or generated.

_source_slide.description: Optional. The source slide or lesson reference for this answer.

definition.description: A concise one-to-two sentence definition. Shown as the lead paragraph in the answer modal.

interview_answer.description: The concise, well-structured answer to deliver in an interview. Shown prominently as the 'What to say' card.

technical_explanation.description: A full in-depth technical breakdown of the concept. Supports multi-line text and inline code references.

best_practice.description: Best practices, do's and don'ts, and production-ready guidance.

real_project_example.description: A real-world story-style example from a production project demonstrating the concept.

code_snippets.description: One or more illustrative code examples for this answer.

label.description: Optional caption shown above the code block.

highlight_lines.description: Optional. Line numbers to visually emphasize in the rendered code block.

architecture_note.description: An architecture-level explanation, optionally accompanied by a Mermaid diagram.

description.description: Prose description of the architectural concept.

mermaid_graph.description: A valid Mermaid diagram string (graph TD, sequenceDiagram, etc.).

differentiator.description: A side-by-side comparison block, used when the question is about comparing two concepts.

comparison_table.description: A markdown-formatted comparison table (| Feature | A | B | format).

troubleshooting.description: Common issues, causes, and fixes related to this concept.

table.description: A markdown-formatted table with columns: Issue | Cause | Resolution.

follow_up_questions.description: A list of follow-up interview questions that a technical interviewer might ask after this one.

validation_metadata.description: Auto-generated validation flags from the answer processing pipeline.
